brief:
A forthcoming review is expected to reveal that three in five Jewish pupils have experienced antisemitism in schools, according to Middle East Eye. The findings may prompt new restrictions on teacher clothing and accessories, potentially prohibiting items including "Free Palestine" badges and watermelon symbols, which pro-Palestinian activists use as emblems of solidarity.

The review comes amid heightened scrutiny of antisemitism in British educational settings and broader debate over acceptable speech and symbols in school environments.

title: UK considers ban on pro-Palestine teacher badges
